## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; strong sector breadth conflicts with pronounced large-cap divergences (multiple RECOVERY and CORRECTION cases), supporting the CAUTION read. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 5 sectors), so cautionary stance rather than a full risk-off.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: +9.28%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples strong: MNST (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +6.40%) CORRECTION. Materials showing strength: FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Industrials lag: DE (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%) CORRECTION. Technology has notable weakness pockets: NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary mixed with dispersion: LOW (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND while F (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +4.57%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND; NFLX (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY; FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY; CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5). Style: Mixed / no clear single style dominance.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: DE (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -17.17%) BELOW TREND; LOW (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND; GILD (1W: -4.86% | 1M: +1.99%) CORRECTION; DOW (1W: -4.75% | 1M: +7.52%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in established Industrials/old-tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Fastest 1W movers: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND; NFLX (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY; FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY; CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY. Major divergence: ≥3 large names in RECOVERY (NFLX, PYPL, CRM) — tactical signals, not clear market-confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with divergence: AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%) RECOVERY; GOOGL (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -8.12%) RECOVERY. Tech breadth: ~18/24 positive (internal rotation); look for confirmation before adding exposure.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Patchy: PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: -0.62% | 1M: +1.94%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND. Financials breadth: ~12/20 positive; favors selective cyclical/transactional names over broad exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mostly steady but mixed headlines: JNJ (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +1.40%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.26%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare breadth: ~11/17 positive; defensive characteristics intact but watch headline risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to Utilities and Materials (CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor Financials’ recovery names; reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap techs showing BELOW TREND (NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND). Major divergence across RECOVERY names suggests tactical entries only after confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND; MNST (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND — momentum confirmed.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -17.17%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Utilities (Breadth strong; CEG leadership) and Materials (FCX strength).  
BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.76%; internal signs of profit-taking) and selective Tech pockets (NVDA, ACN).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: failure to regain a positive 1W trend would keep it BELOW TREND and at risk of further distribution. AAPL: sustaining ABOVE TREND momentum (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) would confirm leadership retention. FCX/CEG: continued weekly strength would validate sector rotation into cyclicals/utilities. Monitor CRM/PYPL/NFLX for trend confirmation before treating rallies as durable.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
FCX (+60): Freeport extension headline; FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed by price.  
MNST (+55): Q4 beat; MNST (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.  
INTU (+55) noted in news but lacking timeframe in this dataset — monitor for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
F (-75): recall headline; F (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +4.57%) ABOVE TREND — bearish news diverging from price (distribution risk).  
CRM (-45): weak earnings reaction; CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY — negative headlines with a short-term bounce, watch for fade.  
JNJ (-55): talc verdict headline; JNJ (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) CORRECTION — news confirming increased headline risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with mixed style (mixed / no clear leadership). CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across RECOVERY names (NFLX, PYPL, CRM) and conflicting headlines (F, CRM) — monitor for trend confirmation before reallocating core exposure.
